notes: The 58 LAB rows are a complete table subsection, not the full exhibition population. No overall completion percentage is calculated.
All table rows were read in source order from ADVENT ATUM through Work-Out. Country labels and TBC qualifiers are preserved without normalization.
All 58 LAB booth codes are distinct; uniqueness of booths does not establish enterprise identity or onsite presence.
Table totals and final row were checked in separate official-page retrievals; these are the same publisher source, not independent confirmation.
The press guide includes a hall-level overview; it is not a booth map or onsite survey. Its forward-looking wording indicates pre-event planning.
Any number advertised as expected exhibitors is not used as a denominator.
